title: Chrissy Teigen Looks Unbothered In A Plaid Skirt In New Instagram Post After Facing Backlash For Her Appearance On Meghan Markle's Netflix Show - NewsBreak
text: Chrissy Teigen may be facing some criticism over her upcoming appearance in Meghan Markle’s Netflix cooking series With Love, Meghan , but she’s proving she’s unbothered—and stylish—in her latest outing. The model and cookbook author joined husband John Legend to celebrate the launch of her Cravings sauce line at L.A. hotspot Jon & Vinny’s, and the couple turned heads with their chic looks. Teigen stunned in a daring ensemble featuring a sheer blouse layered over a black lace bustier. She styled it with a unique maxi skirt that resembled an elongated plaid shirt, complete with ruched detailing at the waist. Her floor-grazing skirt concealed her shoes, while a sleek handbag completed the look. Legend, meanwhile, looked sharp in bright red trousers paired with a crisp white shirt and blazer. He finished his outfit with a matching red pocket square and white loafers, perfectly complementing Teigen’s bold style. In her Instagram photo dump, the mom of four shared behind-the-scenes moments from the night, including her son bringing a plate of chicken cutlets back to the table, her kids hanging out with the DJ, and sweet snapshots of friends mingling as everyone enjoyed the food and festivities. Most recently, the internet erupted with backlash over Teigen’s appearance in Season 2 of the Duchess’ Netflix series With Love, Meghan . Viewers flooded social media with criticism, slamming her cameo in the promo clip. Much of the backlash traces back to Chrissy’s past online behavior, particularly her controversial exchanges with fellow model and TV personality Courtney Stodden, whom she was accused of bullying as a teenager. “Birds of the same feather…” commented one user. A second said, “Bully fits to Bully.” A third wrote, “BATTLE OF THE BULLIES!!!” Someone else commented, “How can Meghan Markle associate with Chrissy Teigan [sic], a self-confessed online bully and troll, when she purports to support the Parents Network, who are campaigning against this very thing?”
